name: foundry-player
description: Lets your own Claude read your character and the books from the table's Foundry. Read-only.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the table's read-only player endpoint over HTTPS. You paste the Client ID and Client Secret you were given; nothing else is installed. Claude can read your own character and short book passages, and cannot change anything.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: The Client ID the table's host gave you.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: The Client Secret the table's host gave you.

endpoint_url.title: Endpoint address
endpoint_url.description: The https:// address of the player endpoint. Already filled in if the host built this file with one.
